text:
deploy-bot: promo hold — CI pipeline failed for release v2.7.1. job: ci/integration-staging-aws failed (TestDBCleanup). logs: https://ci.example.com/build/9678/logs
ci-bot: job failed on shard 3/4. 1/5 reruns passed. failing stack: 
```
panic: timeout waiting for db connection
 at integration/db_cleanup_test.go:82
```
alex: looking into it now
alex: I can repro locally sometimes with `make test-integration DB_TIMEOUT=15` — it flakes quickly, looks like a race in cleanup
maria: last good image dig for this pipeline was sha256:abc123 from 1744930000, might be useful to compare
sam: option: pin promote to abc123 and run smoke. downside: skip PR#456 patch. thoughts?
jen: @dan-oncall can you approve emergency pin if we go that route? change window open til 16:00 UTC
dan: oncall here. I can approve but need a QA smoke pass on staging (~30m). post proof and I'll ack
alex: logs show timeout talking to ephemeral DB, not OOM. suspect ordering of cleanup + parallel inserts in test data
maria: test does `DELETE FROM sessions WHERE created_at < now()` — could be clock/ordering related. Also saw `sql: connection closed` frequently
sam: proposed plan:
1) pin promotion to image sha256:abc123
2) run staging smoke (basic endpoints + job runner)
3) cutover later after canary e2e, and revert pin once fix merged
alex: I can run the pin: `deploybot promote --tag v2.7.1 --image-digest=sha256:abc123 --reason "pin flaky DB cleanup test"`
dan: please post release notes update + rollback plan. I'll sign off after smoke. :thumbsup:
jen: also create an issue to track root cause and backport if needed
alex: created issue #789 "Investigate TestDBCleanup flakiness" — assigned to @maria. triggering manual rerun to collect more logs
ci-bot: manual rerun queued: https://ci.example.com/build/9678/rerun
sam: ok pin + smoke. alex, run the promote and post smoke result here
alex: starting promote now, command run, waiting on deploybot output
deploy-bot: Promote completed — image pinned to sha256:abc123 for v2.7.1, promoted to staging. smoke check triggered
alex: smoke passed (basic healthchecks + /health, /api/status, worker-queue). no 500s observed
jen: good. let's schedule cut tomorrow morning. add note in release notes: "image pinned to sha256:abc123 due to flaky TestDBCleanup; rollback plan: revert to sha256:def456 if unexpected behavior observed"
dan: recording decision & approvals. I'll watch next CI runs and escalate if failure spikes. marking this thread resolved after canary completes
sam: :rocket:
